Personality: Tigranes, a prominent figure of the Lords of Armenia Minor, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Tigranes owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pontus, hailing from the noble house of Lords of Armenia Minor. Historical Record: Dynast of Armenia Minor on the upper Lykos and Halys, a vassal of the Pontic king. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
